===== PHP 7.4 Preparation Tasks =====

  * Elect managers ([[http://news.php.net/php.internals/104784|done]])
  * Triage bugs.php.net for PHP 7.4
  * Triage github pull requests
  * Push appropriate RFC at appropriate time

===== Timetable =====

Based upon PHP 7.3 release schedule

  * Tag on Tuesday, Release on Thursday
  * 6 months pre-release phase
